title: Ukrainian soldier’s frontline phone messages show tragic human cost of maintaining resistance against Russian forces in Kostiantynivka (Ukraine Battlefield update, day 1,707)
lede: Russia claims it has captured the city of Kostiantynivka, but the fighting continues, as chronicled in messages to his wife by 42-year-old Hennadii Osadchyi.

title: Frontex gets 17,000 extra officers for deportations while human-rights monitoring suffers downgrade
lede: The European Commission says Frontex's human rights monitoring won't fundamentally change, citing the need to avoid duplication with EU states. But the text of its proposal suggests otherwise.
